record.paper_title: New results and open problems on Toeplitz operators in Bergman spaces
record.original_question: On the unit disk D, let A^p denote the Bergman space of analytic functions in L^p(D), and let T_a f = P(af) be the Toeplitz operator induced by a symbol a via the Bergman projection P. Find a sufficient and necessary condition for T_a to be bounded on A^p when the symbol is allowed to be merely L^1, locally integrable, or even distributional. In particular, for locally integrable symbols a, is the weighted-Sobolev condition a in W^{-m,∞}_ν(D) from equation (2.10) also necessary for boundedness of T_a : A^p -> A^p when 1 < p < ∞, at least in the Hilbert case p = 2?

evidence.quote: Problem 1. Find a sufficient and necessary condition for Toeplitz operators with L1, or L1loc, or distributional symbols to be bounded on Bergman spaces Ap (for 1 < p < ∞ or at least for p = 2). Notice that for locally integrable and thus for L1-symbols, the condition (2.10) makes very well sense, and in view of Proposition 7 it is to be expected that (2.10) is weaker than (2.4). We in particular ask, if (2.10) is also a necessary condition for the boundedness of Ta : Ap → Ap, 1 < p < ∞, say, for a ∈ L1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D} = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : |z| < 1\}$ be the open unit disk, equipped with normalized area measure $dA$. For $1 < p < \infty$, let $A^p = A^p(\mathbb{D})$ denote the Bergman space of analytic functions $f : \mathbb{D} \to \mathbb{C}$ with $\|f\|_{A^p}^p = \int_\mathbb{D} |f(z)|^p\, dA(z) < \infty$. Let $P : L^2(\mathbb{D}) \to A^2$ denote the orthogonal Bergman projection, defined by $(Pg)(z) = \int_\mathbb{D} \frac{g(w)}{(1-z\bar w)^2}\, dA(w)$, which extends naturally to a class of distributional symbols.

For a symbol $a$ (taken to be in $L^1(\mathbb{D})$, $L^1_{\mathrm{loc}}(\mathbb{D})$, or a suitable space of distributions on $\mathbb{D}$), define formally the Toeplitz operator $T_a f = P(a f)$ on analytic polynomials $f$.

For a non-negative integer $m$ and a radial weight $\nu$ on $\mathbb{D}$ comparable to $(1-|z|)^{2m}$ near $\partial \mathbb{D}$, define the weighted negative-order Sobolev space $W^{-m,\infty}_\nu(\mathbb{D})$ as the space of distributions $a$ that can be represented as
$$ a = \sum_{|\alpha| \le m} \partial^\alpha b_\alpha, \qquad \text{with each } b_\alpha \in L^\infty(\mathbb{D}, \nu),$$
i.e., $\nu^{1/2} b_\alpha \in L^\infty(\mathbb{D})$, and equip it with the natural quotient norm.

(a) Find a condition on the symbol $a$ that is both necessary and sufficient for $T_a$ to extend to a bounded linear operator $A^p \to A^p$, in the three settings $a \in L^1(\mathbb{D})$, $a \in L^1_{\mathrm{loc}}(\mathbb{D})$, and $a$ a distribution, for $1 < p < \infty$ (or at least for the Hilbert case $p = 2$).

(b) In particular, for $a \in L^1_{\mathrm{loc}}(\mathbb{D})$ (or even $a \in L^1(\mathbb{D})$), determine whether the condition $a \in W^{-m,\infty}_\nu(\mathbb{D})$ for some $m$ — known to be sufficient — is also necessary for the boundedness of $T_a : A^p \to A^p$, $1 < p < \infty$, at least when $p = 2$.
artifact.status_search_result: A complete necessary and sufficient condition for boundedness of Toeplitz operators on Bergman spaces $A^p$ with $L^1$, $L^1_{\mathrm{loc}}$, or distributional symbols is widely cited as still open, even in the Hilbert case $p=2$ on the unweighted Bergman space. Recent work (e.g. Cambridge "Toeplitz operators with distributional symbols on Bergman spaces" and follow-up papers on weighted Bergman spaces) provides sufficient conditions via weighted negative-order Sobolev spaces but does not establish necessity, and surveys continue to list this characterization as unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Toeplitz operators with distributional symbols on Bergman spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies boundedness/compactness of Toeplitz operators with distributional symbols, giving sufficient conditions via weighted Sobolev-type spaces, without a matching necessity result.
status_evidence.claim: Sufficient condition via weighted negative-order Sobolev spaces is established, but a necessary and sufficient characterization is not given.

status_evidence.title: Boundedness of Toeplitz Operators in Bergman-Type Spaces (Springer)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey-style chapter discussing partial results and stating that a full characterization of bounded Toeplitz operators on Bergman spaces remains open even for p=2.
status_evidence.claim: The characterization of bounded Toeplitz operators on Bergman spaces is reported as still open.

status_evidence.title: Invertibility of Bergman Toeplitz operators (arXiv:2510.09614)
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) work on Bergman Toeplitz operators that does not provide a complete necessary-and-sufficient boundedness criterion for general L^1 / distributional symbols.
status_evidence.claim: Recent literature still treats the general boundedness characterization as unresolved.
